questions.explain: Both H₂N(CH₂)₆NH₂ and HOOC(CH₂)₄COOH have six carbon atoms, hence 6,6. Sebacic acid gives nylon-6,10 and glycine + 6-aminohexanoic acid gives nylon-2-nylon-6.

questions.q: Caprolactam, the monomer of nylon-6, is made from cyclohexanone oxime by the
questions.explain: The Beckmann rearrangement converts cyclohexanone oxime into caprolactam, the seven-membered cyclic amide that is ring-opened to nylon-6.
The diamine part has 6 C; the diacid part has (CH₂)₈ plus two C=O carbons, i.e. 10 C (sebacic acid). Counting only the CH₂ groups gives the wrong answer 6,8.

questions.q: Which statement about nylon-6 is correct?
options: It is made by condensing two different monomers
It is an addition polymer of a vinyl monomer
It forms by ring-opening of caprolactam on heating with a little water, yet exam keys class it as a condensation polyamide
questions.explain: Water opens a few caprolactam rings to 6-aminohexanoic acid, whose –NH₂ end then opens further rings; NCERT still lists nylon-6 as a condensation polymer. It melts lower (about 218 °C) than nylon-6,6 (about 264 °C).
